BUCH7 on tests/fixtures/lenses/KingslakeDG.zmx, wavelength 2, object at infinity.

Nine spherical surfaces.  EFL 100.003939,  F/8.000315,  Lagrange 1.558300,
Buchdahl p 0.113648.

WHY THIS FILE EXISTS.  BUCH7_ASPH must reproduce BUCH7 exactly on a system of
spheres - none of its aspheric machinery is reached there, so any difference is a
fault in the transcription and not in the Sec. 85 arrangement.  Stage A and B were
checked against this on 2026-09-15 and agreed at every printed digit: 45 per-surface
third-order values, the five column sums, and all eighteen transverse totals.

Stage D has not been written yet.  When it is, the twenty tau below are what it must
reproduce on this file, and they are recorded here so that the check costs no further
run of OpticStudio.
